prompt:
소인의 뒷모습이 사람들 사이로 사라져갔다. 똑같은 검은색 사이 얼핏 갈색으로 빛나는 그녀의 머리칼을 놓치지 않으려 나의 팔은 자꾸 앞으로 향했다. 

서울역행 열차가 지금 들어옵니다.

철도 소리가 내 고막에 메아리쳐 들린다. 나의 구두가 미끌거리는 계단을 용캐도 붙들며 달려갔다. 

“소인아!”

갈빛의 머리칼이 휘날리는 검은 실들 사이에 우두커니 서있었다. 오고가는 사람들 사이 소인의 검은 눈동자가 나를 반듯하게 향하고 있었다.

“소인아..”

그러나 나의 목소리는 그녀에게 향하지 않는 듯 했다. 너무나 검은 눈동자 속에는 내가 비치면서 담겨있지 않았다.

“나 왜 부른거야.”

“이렇게 헤어지지 말자 우리.”

지하철 문이 닫힙니다. 다음 열차를 이용해주세요.

바쁜 승강장에 멈춰 있는 것은 우리 둘 뿐이었다.

“나랑 왜 계속 만나고 싶은데?”

머릿속에 질문만 돌아다녔다. 그러게. 나는 왜 소인이와 계속 만나고 싶을까. 요즘들어 고민했지만, 늘 대답하지 못했던 질문이었다. 이 질문이 결국 나에게 족쇄로 다가올 줄 지금이 오기까지 나는 몰랐다.

“...”

소인의 눈이 허공을 향했다. 또 그렇듯 그녀의 눈물이 차오르는 것이 보였다.

“넌 나한테서 마음이 떠난거야.”

‘아니야-’ 라는 말이 차마 목구멍 위로 나오지 않았다. 이 울컥거림을 누를 수 있는 다른 말이 필요했다.

“너는?”

“하.”

서울역행 열차가 지금 들어옵니다.

 소인의 머리카락이 기차의 바람에 흔들렸다. 그렇게나 닿고 싶었던 그녀였는데 어째서인지 다가갈 수 없었다. 

문이 열립니다.

 소인이 다른 사람들과 함께 기차 안으로 밀려들어갔다.
나의 고개도 소인을 따라 왼쪽을 향했다.

지하철 문이 닫힙니다. 다음 열차를 이용해주세요.

 나의 눈은 소인을 바라보고 있었다.
 눈물이 났다.

environment.overview: An early-2000s Seoul underground railway station has utilitarian tiled architecture, brushed-metal fittings, dark speckled flooring, pale-gray walls, charcoal recesses, and cool fluorescent light punctuated by amber information displays.

zones.name: Wet stairwell
zones.description: A straight descending flight of dark stone stairs has glossy damp treads, pale tiled sidewalls, stainless-steel handrails, and a low fluorescent ceiling; its open lower end reveals the adjoining landing and an amber arrival repeater

zones.name: Stair landing
zones.description: A broad tiled landing contains the stair opening, a square tiled support column, overhead Seoul-bound directional signs, and the amber arrival repeater; the platform edge and passing trains are visible through its unobstructed opening toward the boarding area

zones.name: Boarding bay
zones.description: A platform section without platform screen doors contains a ribbed safety strip, a square tiled column, an overhead amber information board, and an open track with a dark tiled wall beyond; train doors stop beside the safety strip, and the stair landing opens into the bay at its right-hand end

baseline.weather: light rain aboveground, with tracked-in moisture on the stairs and no precipitation inside
baseline.lighting: steady cool fluorescent illumination, with amber station displays and white train-interior lighting.

breakdown.logline: A desperate narrator chases Soin through a crowded Seoul subway station to stop their breakup, but their inability to explain why they should stay together turns the pursuit into a motionless confrontation, until the next train carries her away.

beats.summary: Soin’s brown hair begins disappearing among black-haired commuters, and the narrator reaches after her
The narrator’s shoes find purchase on the slippery stairs, allowing the pursuit to continue
The narrator calls Soin’s name, stopping her departure through the crowd
Soin turns, but her emotionally distant gaze and question deny the reunion the narrator hoped for
The narrator asks Soin not to end their relationship this way
As the first train closes its doors, Soin asks why the narrator wants to keep seeing her
Tears gather in Soin’s eyes as she concludes that the narrator no longer loves her
Instead of denying it, the narrator asks about her feelings; Soin answers with a bitter exhalation
Another train arrives, stirring Soin’s hair, but the narrator cannot close the distance between them
Boarding commuters carry Soin into the train while the narrator remains outside
The doors close between them, and the narrator finally cries

subjects.name: Narrator
subjects.appearance: tall, lean build, narrow shoulders, a straight mid-gray thigh-length coat over dark trousers, and wet-shining black leather shoes
signature_features: conspicuously long limbs and a narrow, upright silhouette distinguish them from every angle.

subjects.name: Soin
subjects.appearance: short, slight build, near-black knee-length coat, dark straight trousers, flat dark shoes, pale-gray skin, dark eyes, and medium-gray hair representing brown, cut bluntly just above her shoulders
signature_features: compact proportions and the broad, blunt outline of her brown bob remain recognizable from any angle.

subjects.name: Commuters
subjects.appearance: mixed adult heights and builds, predominantly black hair, near-black winter coats, dark trousers, rectangular shoulder bags, and rounded backpacks
signature_features: overlapping dark, blocky silhouettes form a moving visual mass, including one notably broad, short figure and one exceptionally tall, narrow figure.

subjects.name: Seoul-bound train
subjects.kind: Successive, visually matching subway trains on the same service
subjects.appearance: long light-gray metal bodies, a charcoal window band, paired sliding doors, broad rectangular windows, and bright pale interiors
signature_features: elongated rectangular proportions and the repeated dark-window/light-door rhythm identify the trains from front, side, or rear.

spec.shot_name: Soin disappearing into the descending commuters
spec.angle: high, looking down the stairs from behind the narrator
spec.backdrop: Damp stair treads, converging steel handrails, pale tiled walls, and the lower landing’s amber repeater reading “Train bound for Seoul Station entering.”
spec.action: Soin descends ahead of the narrator with her back turned. Moving black coats repeatedly obscure her medium-gray bob. The narrator extends an arm through an opening between commuters, without reaching her.
spec.emotion: Panic at losing one recognizable person inside an anonymous crowd.
spec.transition: Hard cut to the narrator’s shoes.
